projects.title: The Garden of Digital Delights
projects.summary: Mapping the systems behind our digital lives.
projects.description: A ten-week exploration of the cloud, its infrastructure, and the relationships that shape our digital world. This collaborative gigamap brings research, causal connections, and possibilities for intervention into one shared view.

regions.title: Connections & loops
regions.description: Follow the relationships between digital life and the infrastructure behind it.

regions.title: Research & findings
regions.description: Explore the central garden of research, informed by ZIP analysis.

regions.title: Solution framework
regions.description: See the shared framework for individual design interventions.

projects.imageAlt: Full Garden of Digital Delights map, with causal connections, a research garden, and an intervention framework
projects.process: The process moved from causal loops and ZIP analysis to research, a shared solution framework, and individual interventions.

projects.title: Healthcare: A Systems Perspective
projects.summary: A systems view of diabetes care and the experience of living with a chronic condition.
projects.description: A systems perspective on diabetes care in India, exploring how healthcare, awareness, support, and everyday life shape the transition to living with a chronic condition. The map connects a current system view, stakeholder relationships, and the patient journey to identify spaces for design intervention.

regions.title: Context & system view
regions.description: Explore the background and relationships shaping diabetes care.

regions.title: Process & stakeholders
regions.description: Read the problem definition, design process, and stakeholder relationships.

regions.title: Patient journey
regions.description: Follow the journey from a healthy self to living with a chronic condition.

projects.imageAlt: Healthcare gigamap showing diabetes in India, a current system view, stakeholder relationships, and the patient journey

projects.title: Exodus of the Anthropocene
projects.summary: Mapping migration and climate change in India.
projects.description: A systems view of the relationship between climate change, livability, and human migration in India. The gigamap connects climate migration hotspots and environmental stressors with a human livability framework, stakeholder roles, and case studies from Beed and Mumbai.

regions.title: Context & climate hotspots
regions.description: Explore the background and geography of climate migration in India.

regions.title: Livability framework
regions.description: Trace connections between environmental stressors, livability, and migration.

regions.title: Impacts & case studies
regions.description: Explore migration challenges, stakeholder roles, and case studies from Beed and Mumbai.

projects.imageAlt: Exodus of the Anthropocene gigamap showing climate migration hotspots in India, a human livability framework, stakeholders, and case studies from Beed and Mumbai

projects.title: Fallen through the Fabric of Family
projects.summary: A systemic study on India’s child abandonment crisis.
projects.description: The gigamap examines child abandonment in India through the metaphor of a family’s fabric. It connects causes, stakeholder relationships, post-abandonment outcomes, and opportunities for design intervention.

regions.title: Context & overview
regions.description: Read the context and overview of child abandonment in India.

regions.title: Fabric of Family
regions.description: Explore the relationships and responsibilities represented by the family’s fabric.

regions.title: Causes & stakeholders
regions.description: Explore the causal map and stakeholder relationships in the Broken Net.

regions.title: Support & outcomes
regions.description: Read the Net of Redemption and the system of post-abandonment outcomes.

regions.title: Survival & risks
regions.description: Explore the Net of Survival and the risks described in the map.

regions.title: Leverage points
regions.description: Review the potential design opportunity areas identified by the team.

projects.imageAlt: Portrait gigamap about child abandonment in India, using woven family fabric, causal maps, stakeholder relationships, and design intervention points

projects.title: Happiness: Celebration of transient moments!
projects.summary: Exploring the personal, social and cultural factors that shape happiness and wellbeing.
projects.description: The map brings together cultural perspectives, scientific explanations, psychological frameworks and philosophical ideas about happiness. A central network connects 15 determinants with their influencing factors, followed by an emotion canvas and a happiness framework.

regions.title: Understanding
regions.description: Explore cultural, scientific, psychological and philosophical perspectives on happiness.

regions.title: Analysis
regions.description: Trace the network of 15 happiness determinants and their influencing factors.

regions.title: Synthesis
regions.description: Read the emotion canvas and the happiness framework.

projects.imageAlt: Wide gigamap with a world happiness atlas and explanatory diagrams on the left, a branching network of happiness determinants in the centre, and emotion-canvas and happiness-framework diagrams on the right.

projects.title: The Silent Crisis
projects.summary: Exploring the ecological and human costs of biodiversity loss and conservation.
projects.description: The map connects biodiversity and ecosystem services with the economic, social, cultural, political and emotional costs of neglect and conservation. Its central tree traces these relationships, alongside stakeholder roles and a case study of community commons in the semi-arid regions of Chikkaballapur, Karnataka.
projects.imageAlt: Wide charcoal gigamap with biodiversity charts on the left, a branching tree linking ecological and human costs in the centre, and a Karnataka map, community commons case study and conservation opportunities on the right.

regions.title: Biodiversity & ecosystem services
regions.description: Explore the context of biodiversity loss and the ecosystem services that support human life.

regions.title: The tree of cost and care
regions.description: Trace the costs of neglect and conservation, causal relationships and stakeholder roles.

regions.title: Commons & conservation
regions.description: Explore community commons in Chikkaballapur, Karnataka, and the proposed path ahead.

projects.title: Transcending Dualities of Gender
projects.summary: Mapping the social, cultural, and legal influences on the lives of trans people in India.
projects.description: The map brings together gender identity, historical and legal context, individual life journeys, and an influence map. It traces relationships among education, healthcare, livelihoods, family support, and public policy, then identifies stakeholders and opportunities for change.

regions.description: Trace the relationships affecting the lives of trans people.

regions.title: Stakeholders & change
regions.description: Explore causal loops, key actors, and opportunities for change.

projects.title: House of Vulnerability
projects.summary: Exploring vulnerability and resilience across India’s socioeconomic landscape.
projects.description: Using a house of cards metaphor, the map explores how economic, social, environmental, political, technological, physical and educational factors shape vulnerability across income groups in India. It brings together historical context and a framework for assessing the effects of policies and interventions at individual, community and collective levels.
projects.imageAlt: Wide charcoal gigamap with a colourful house of cards illustrating vulnerability and resilience across income groups, contextual charts and a historical timeline on the left, and a layered policy assessment framework and research insights on the right.
